idea: Ajo is a rotating savings circle for people who save together in Ajo, Tandas, and Susu groups. The NEAR contract holds the pot, so the organizer never does. Each member mints a non-transferable reputation pass. Bronze locks the full remaining stake. A Silver pass locks half, and a named voucher locks the other half. If the person who was paid first stops paying, both locks are seized and every later honest member is still paid. Circles can take a NEP-141 stablecoin, a relayer can sponsor gas for the round deposit only, and a dry NEAR Intents quote shows how a member can fund USDC on NEAR from USDC they already hold on another chain.
